content: Adjusting insulin doses in both basal and bolus regimens necessitates meticulous monitoring and a thorough understanding of the pharmacodynamic properties of each type of insulin. Additionally, regular evaluations of hemoglobin A1C levels and the frequency of hypoglycemic episodes are essential components of effective management. In some cases, simplifying or discontinuing complex insulin regimens can be beneficial. This approach may help certain patients, particularly elderly individuals, achieve better glucose control and enhance their overall quality of life.
